<script>
      
  // Function to set a cookie with an expiration time
function setCookie(name, value, hours) {
    const expires = new Date();
    expires.setTime(expires.getTime() + (hours * 60 * 60 * 1000));
    document.cookie = `${name}=${value};expires=${expires.toUTCString()};path=/`;
}

// Function to get a cookie value
function getCookie(name) {
    const nameEQ = name + "=";
    const ca = document.cookie.split(';');
    for (let i = 0; i < ca.length; i++) {
        let c = ca[i];
        while (c.charAt(0) === ' ') c = c.substring(1, c.length);
        if (c.indexOf(nameEQ) === 0) return c.substring(nameEQ.length, c.length);
    }
    return null;
}

// Function to delete a cookie
function eraseCookie(name) {
    document.cookie = name + '=; Max-Age=-99999999;';
}

// Function to fetch the help center integration token
async function fetchHCIntegrationToken() {
    try {
        const response = await fetch('/api/v2/help_center/integration/token.json');
        if (!response.ok) throw new Error('Network response was not ok to get hc integration token.');
        const data = await response.json();
        return data.token;
    } catch (error) {
        console.error('Failed to fetch help center integration token:', error);
    }
}
                                          
// Function to request a new JWT token using the hc integration token and additional data
async function fetchJwtToken(bearerToken) {

    const postData = {
  	    userName: '',
        subdomain: 'vimeosupport' // Include subdomain in request data
    };

    try {
        const response = await fetch('https://us-central1-vimeo-infra.cloudfunctions.net/zendesk_messenger_login', {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: {
                'Authorization': `Bearer ${bearerToken}`,
                'Content-Type': 'application/json'
            },
            body: JSON.stringify(postData)
        });
        if (!response.ok) throw new Error('Network response was not ok to create jwt token.');
        const data = await response.json();
        return data.jwtToken;
    } catch (error) {
        console.error('Failed to fetch JWT token:', error);
    }
}

// Function to fetch and set the JWT token
async function fetchAndSetJwtToken() {
    try {
        const hc_integrationToken = await fetchHCIntegrationToken();

        if (hc_integrationToken) {
            const jwtToken = await fetchJwtToken(hc_integrationToken);

            if (jwtToken) {
                setCookie('messenger', jwtToken, 1); // Store the token for 1 hour
                return jwtToken; // Return the new JWT token
            }
        }
    } catch (error) {
        console.error('Failed to fetch and set JWT token:', error);
    }
}

// Function to initialize JWT token management
async function initializeJwtToken() {
    let jwtToken = getCookie('messenger');
    if (!jwtToken) {
        jwtToken = await fetchAndSetJwtToken(); // Fetch and set the token if not present
    }

    // Use the token in the zE function
    zE('messenger', 'loginUser', function (callback) {
        callback(jwtToken);
    });

    // Refresh the JWT token every 55 minutes
    setInterval(async () => {
        jwtToken = await fetchAndSetJwtToken(); // Fetch and set the new token
    }, 55 * 60 * 1000); // Refresh every 55 minutes
}

function detectBrowser() {
  const userAgent = navigator.userAgent;
  let browserName = "Unknown";
  let browserVersion = "Unknown";
  
  // Detect Chrome
  if (/Chrome/.test(userAgent) && !/Chromium|Edge|Edg|OPR|Opera|Brave|Vivaldi/.test(userAgent)) {
    browserName = "Chrome";
    const match = userAgent.match(/Chrome\/(\d+\.\d+\.\d+\.\d+)/);
    browserVersion = match ? match[1] : "Unknown";
  }
  // Detect Firefox
  else if (/Firefox/.test(userAgent) && !/Seamonkey/.test(userAgent)) {
    browserName = "Firefox";
    const match = userAgent.match(/Firefox\/(\d+\.\d+)/);
    browserVersion = match ? match[1] : "Unknown";
  }
  // Detect Safari (only for macOS as iOS Safari has different UA)
  else if (/Safari/.test(userAgent) && !/Chrome|Chromium|Edge|Edg|OPR|Opera/.test(userAgent)) {
    browserName = "Safari";
    const match = userAgent.match(/Version\/(\d+\.\d+\.\d+)/);
    browserVersion = match ? match[1] : "Unknown";
  }
  // Detect Edge (Chromium-based)
  else if (/Edg/.test(userAgent)) {
    browserName = "Edge";
    const match = userAgent.match(/Edg\/(\d+\.\d+\.\d+\.\d+)/);
    browserVersion = match ? match[1] : "Unknown";
  }
  // Detect Opera
  else if (/OPR|Opera/.test(userAgent)) {
    browserName = "Opera";
    const match = userAgent.match(/(?:OPR|Opera)\/(\d+\.\d+\.\d+)/);
    browserVersion = match ? match[1] : "Unknown";
  }
  // Detect IE
  else if (/MSIE|Trident/.test(userAgent)) {
    browserName = "Internet Explorer";
    const match = userAgent.match(/(?:MSIE |rv:)(\d+\.\d+)/);
    browserVersion = match ? match[1] : "Unknown";
  }
  
  return {
    name: browserName,
    version: browserVersion
  };
}
function extractPlatformFromUA(userAgentString) {
    // Basic input validation
    if (!userAgentString || typeof userAgentString !== 'string') {
      console.error("Invalid input: userAgentString must be a non-empty string.");
      return null;
    }
    const regex = /\((.*?)\)/;

    const match = userAgentString.match(regex);
    if (match && match[1]) {
      return match[1]; // Return the captured platform string
    } else {
      // Pattern not found
      console.warn("Could not find platform information within parentheses in the UA string:", userAgentString);
      return null;
    }
  }

                fallback = '/upload',

            // Callbacks
            webkitHiddenCallback = function() {
                // If the user is still here open the url page.
                if (!document.webkitHidden) {
                    window.location = fallback;
                }
            };

            // Try to open the Vimeo App
            hitCallback = function() {
                window.location = deeplink;
                setTimeout(webkitHiddenCallback, 25);

function updateFocusToHashAnchor() {
    if (location.hash != "") {
        let desiredLocationHash = location.hash;
        location.hash = "";
        location.hash = desiredLocationHash;
    }
}

function drawYellowBoxAroundNotices() {
    const noticeSectionRegex = RegExp('^Notice:');
    document.querySelectorAll('.legal_doc .otnotice p').forEach(
        (node) => {
            if (noticeSectionRegex.test(node.outerText)) {
                node.style = yellowBoxStyle;
            }
        }
    );
}

function addTogglableContent() {
    const READ_MORE = " Read More";
    const READ_LESS = " Read Less";
    const TOGGLE_START_MARKER = "READ_MORE_START"
    const TOGGLE_END_MARKER = "READ_MORE_END"

    function addListener(element, eventName, handler) {
        if (element.addEventListener) {
            element.addEventListener(eventName, handler, false);
        }
        else if (element.attachEvent) {
            element.attachEvent('on' + eventName, handler);
        }
        else {
            element['on' + eventName] = handler;
        }
    }

    function toggleVisibility(element) {
        if (element.style.display === "none") {
            element.style.display = "block";
        } else {
            element.style.display = "none";
        }
    }

    function toggleLinkText(element) {
        if (element.innerHTML === READ_MORE) {
            element.innerHTML = READ_LESS;
        } else {
            element.innerHTML = READ_MORE;
        }
    }

    document.querySelector('.otnotice').querySelectorAll('p').forEach((pNode, i) => {

        // Identify all the <p> tags that contain the start marker
        if (pNode.innerHTML.indexOf(TOGGLE_START_MARKER) != -1) {

            // Find the previous non-text HTML element, and the previous HTML text element
            let prevSibling = pNode.previousSibling;
            if (prevSibling == null) {
                return
            }
            while (prevSibling.lastChild !== null && prevSibling.lastChild.nodeType == prevSibling.ELEMENT_NODE){
                prevSibling = prevSibling.lastChild;
            }
            prevText = prevSibling;
            while (prevText.lastChild !== null){
                prevText = prevText.lastChild;
            }

            // Create <div> to hold togglable content
            let togglableContent = document.createElement('div');

            // Add <a> link to toggle visibility of togglable content
            var temp_link = document.createElement("a");
            temp_link.innerHTML = READ_MORE;
            addListener(temp_link,
                "click",
                function() {
                    toggleVisibility(togglableContent);
                    toggleLinkText(temp_link);
                }
            );
            prevText.parentNode.appendChild(temp_link);

            // Append the togglable content, after appending the link
            prevSibling.appendChild(togglableContent);

            // Fill the togglable <div> with all the HTML until the end marker is found
            let iterNode = pNode.nextSibling;
            let nodesToAppend = []
            while (iterNode != null) {
                if (iterNode.innerHTML.indexOf(TOGGLE_END_MARKER) == -1) {
                    nodesToAppend.push(iterNode);
                    iterNode = iterNode.nextSibling;
                } else {
                    iterNode.parentNode.removeChild(iterNode);
                    iterNode = null;
                }
            }
            nodesToAppend.forEach(n => {togglableContent.appendChild(n);});
            pNode.parentNode.removeChild(pNode);
            togglableContent.style = yellowBoxStyle;

            // Initially hide all the togglable content
            togglableContent.style.display = "none";
        }
    });
}

function renameOneTrustHeaderTags() {
    const ONETRUST_CLASS_SELECTOR = '.otnotice'
    const punctuationRegex = /[ '"`.,\/\\><#!$%?@\^&\*+;:{}=\~()-]/g;
    const allHeaderTagsQuerySelector = 'h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6';
    const regexForNumericPrefix = /^[0-9]+[.][0-9]* /;
    const regexForDuplicateUnderscores = /[_]{2,}/g;
    const regexForLeadingUnderscores = /^_+/g;
    const regexForTrailingUnderscores = /_+$/g;
    document.querySelector(ONETRUST_CLASS_SELECTOR).querySelectorAll(allHeaderTagsQuerySelector).forEach(
        (node) => {
            let newNameForTag = node.textContent
                .replace(regexForNumericPrefix, "")
                .replace(punctuationRegex, "_")
                .replace(regexForDuplicateUnderscores, "_")
                .replace(regexForLeadingUnderscores, "")
                .replace(regexForTrailingUnderscores, "")
                .toLowerCase();
            node.setAttribute(
                "id",
                newNameForTag
            );
        }
    );
}

function replaceUpdatedDate() {
    if (window.last_updated != null) {
        const element = document.querySelector("#page_title");
        if (element) {
            const nextSibling = element.nextSibling;
            if(nextSibling) {
                nextSibling.textContent = window.last_updated;
            }
        }
    }
}

    OneTrust.NoticeApi.Initialized.then(function() {
            page_info = document.getElementById('vimeo_onetrust_page_src');
            url = page_info.dataset.url;
            production = page_info.dataset.prod;

                .then(renameOneTrustHeaderTags)
                .then(replaceUpdatedDate)
                .then(drawYellowBoxAroundNotices)
                .then(addTogglableContent)
                .then(updateFocusToHashAnchor);
                
    });
})();

We will remove this type of content, regardless of who posted it or with what intention, to reduce the chances of others using it for unintended or harmful purposes.</p><p>If we locate any content suspected of containing CSAM, we will immediately remove the account and report the incident to the National Center for Missing and Exploited Children.</p><p><br></p><p>If you intend to watch Vimeo with your kids or upload any content featuring them, please read our <a href="https://vimeo.com/help/guidelines/parentalguidelines" target="_blank" rel="nofollow noopener noreferrer">Parental Guidance </a>for tips on how to keep them safe.</p></div></li></ul><ul><li>Depicts or encourages self-harm or suicide <a> Read More</a><div style="border: 1px solid black; background-color: rgb(255, 242, 204); padding: 10px; display: none;"><p>Self-harm and Suicide </p><p>We do not allow content that depicts or encourages self-harm or suicide. This includes but is not limited to content that:</p><ul><li>Promotes or glorifies suicide </li><li>Provides instructions on how to self-harm or die by suicide</li><li>Encourages eating disorders</li></ul><p>We do allow videos where users talk openly about depression, self-harm, suicide or other mental health issues, or about their own experiences with these issues, to educate the public, raise awareness and help others. </p></div></li></ul><ul><li>Depicts (1) unlawful real-world acts of extreme violence, (2) vivid, realistic, or particularly graphic acts of violence and brutality, (3) sexualized violence, including rape, torture, abuse, and humiliation, or (4) animal cruelty or extreme violence towards animals <a> Read More</a><div style="border: 1px solid black; background-color: rgb(255, 242, 204); padding: 10px; display: none;"><h3 id="excessive_violence">Excessive Violence</h3><p>We do not allow content that:</p><ul><li>Incites violence</li><li>Show people being murdered, tortured, or physically or sexually abused</li><li>Depict self-mutilation or encourage it</li><li>Show animals being tortured or killed</li><li>Display shocking, disgusting, or gruesome images</li></ul><p>That said, Vimeo understands that there can be videos that engage with these subjects in a critical, thoughtful way, or bring light to a subject that might otherwise go unreported. However, content that seeks primarily to disturb or shock the viewer (e.g., through the use of gore) will generally not be permitted.</p><p>Finally, videos that depict violence in a way that complies with our Guidelines must be marked with a “Mature” content rating to be displayed on Vimeo.com. See <a href="#content_ratings_vimeo_com_only" rel="nofollow"><strong>Section 1.6</strong></a> (Content Ratings) below for more information.</p></div></li></ul><ul><li>Promotes fraudulent or dubious money-making schemes, proposes an unlawful transaction, or uses deceptive marketing practices <a> Read More</a><div style="border: 1px solid black; background-color: rgb(255, 242, 204); padding: 10px; display: none;"><h3 id="deceptive_schemes">Deceptive Schemes</h3><p>We do not allow content that promotes:</p><ul><li>Illegal schemes (like Pyramid/Ponzi schemes)</li><li>Businesses that promise wealth with little or no effort</li><li>Unregistered securities offerings (absent a legal basis)</li><li>Illegal products or services </li><li>Products or services (even if legal) using deceptive marketing practices </li></ul><p>In addition, users may not use Vimeo.com’s messaging capabilities for unsolicited direct marketing purposes.</p></div></li></ul><ul><li>Conveys false or misleading claims about (1) vaccination safety, or (2) health-related information that has a serious potential to cause individual or public harm <a> Read More</a><div style="border: 1px solid black; background-color: rgb(255, 242, 204); padding: 10px; display: none;"><h3 id="health_misinformation">Health Misinformation</h3><p>We do not allow health-related content that might cause people to take dangerous or unproven treatments or refrain from taking indicated precautions or treatments that the U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) or World Health Organization (WHO) recommend. We also do not allow claims that an epidemic or pandemic (such as COVID-19) are conspiracies. </p><h3 id="vaccine_misinformation">Vaccine Misinformation</h3><p>We do not allow claims that vaccines are unsafe for a general population unless the CDC or WHO have substantiated the claim. This includes claims that vaccines:</p><ul><li>Cause or contribute to childhood autism (including the claim that the MMR vaccine is linked to autism)</li><li>Infant immune systems cannot handle multiple vaccines</li><li>Natural immunity is better than vaccine-acquired immunity</li><li>Vaccines contain unsafe toxins</li><li>Vaccines can infect people with the infectious disease they are trying to prevent</li><li>Vaccines are not necessary to combat the spread of infectious diseases</li></ul><p>In addition, we do not allow content that promotes an agent or treatment for use to vaccinate against a particular infectious disease if it has not been specifically approved for such purpose by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration or another similar governmental body. </p><h3 id="abortion_misinformation">Abortion Misinformation</h3><p>We do not allow content that seeks to provide false or misleading information regarding the safety and availability of abortion care. This includes:</p><ul><li>Promotion of abortion methods other than chemical or surgical methods deemed safe by the CDC and WHO</li><li>Claims that misrepresent the safety or side effects of chemical or surgical abortions deemed safe by the CDC and WHO</li><li>Content that misrepresents the availability of abortion care at a provider</li><li>Content that misrepresents when an abortion may be safely conducted</li><li>Claims that ectopic pregnancies can be safely carried to full term</li><li>Promotion of so-called “abortion reversal pills”</li></ul><p>Examples of content that is not prohibited by this policy:</p><ul><li>Debates about abortion laws (whether pro or con)</li><li>Objections to abortion based upon religious or moral reasons</li><li>Debates about when life begins</li><li>Content promoting safe abortion alternatives</li></ul></div></li></ul><ul><li>Spreads false or misleading information about voting or seeks to obstruct voting <a> Read More</a><div style="border: 1px solid black; background-color: rgb(255, 242, 204); padding: 10px; display: none;"><h3 id="voter_suppression">Voter Suppression</h3><p>We do not allow content that spreads false or misleading information on voter eligibility, voter registration, and the voting process (e.g., time, place, manner, requirements) in a manner that might cause a reasonable voter to fail to take an action that would allow that person to effectively vote. We also do not allow content that seeks to intimidate or harass voters.</p><h3 id="election_interference">Election Interference</h3><p>We do not allow content that: calls for violence over voting or an election; seeks to intimidate or harass persons who administer voting or elections; or encourages others to do any of the foregoing or to interfere with or obstruct the voting or election process.</p><h3 id="misinformation_about_elections_results">Misinformation about Elections Results</h3><p>We do not allow false and misleading information about the results of an election where the content:</p><ul><li>contains an explicit or implicit call for violence or unlawful activity;</li><li>defames, intimidates, or harasses people or companies involved in administering elections; or</li><li>is part of an apparent campaign to spread disinformation on Vimeo.com (e.g., multiple accounts created to spread the content or other coordinated behavior).</li></ul><h3 id="candidate_eligibility">Candidate Eligibility</h3><p>We do not allow content that spreads false or misleading information about a candidate's technical eligibility requirements for an elected office (e.g., age, citizenship, address).</p></div></li></ul><ul><li>Contains (1) claims that a real-world tragedy did not occur; (2) false claims that a violent crime or catastrophe has occurred; or (3) false or misleading information (including fake news, deepfakes, propaganda, or unproven or debunked conspiracy theories) that creates a serious risk of material harm to a person, group, or the general public <a> Read More</a><div style="border: 1px solid black; background-color: rgb(255, 242, 204); padding: 10px; display: none;"><h3 id="false_and_misleading_content">False and Misleading Content</h3><p>We do not allow:</p><ul><li>Claims that established events such as genocides, school shootings, or terrorist attacks did not happen.</li><li>Claims that a disaster or other emergency did occur when no such event happened.</li><li>Fake news, highly deceptive manipulated media (e.g., deepfakes), propaganda, conspiracy theory-related content, or any other false and misleading information that creates a serious risk of real-world-harms to individuals, groups, and the general public. Examples include:<ul><li>QAnon-related content</li><li>Disinformation that seeks to stoke violence or insurrection</li><li>War propaganda by foreign governments</li></ul></li></ul></div></li></ul><ul><li>Violates any applicable law</li></ul><h3 id="screen_name_profile_picture_and_avatar">1.4 Screen Name, Profile Picture and Avatar</h3><p>You may not use screen names, profile pictures or avatars that are offensive (e.g., names with explicit language), depict any nudity, display symbols associated with gangs, hate groups, or terror organizations, or violate the content restrictions in Section 1.3 above.</p><h3 id="considerations">1.5 Considerations</h3><p>In making decisions, we consider the entire context of the content to determine whether there may be a valid reason for including certain types of speech, such as newsworthiness, discussion of a religious text, criticism, or dramatic or narrative purposes (for fictional works). Such purposes may not be used, however, as mere devices to justify problematic speech (i.e., Restricted Content under our <a href="https://vimeo.com/terms" target="_blank" rel="nofollow noopener noreferrer">Acceptable Use Policy</a>, as detailed in Section 1.3 above). We may also consider related content (like title, description, and tags) and information outside of Vimeo, such as the user’s activities elsewhere, materials linked from Vimeo, and the intended audience. </p><h3 id="captioning">1.6 Captioning</h3><p>If you submit content that is also distributed on television, you must provide captioning. Similarly, if you are under any legal obligation to provide captioning, you must do so. Even if you are not required to do so, we strongly encourage you to provide them so that we can provide the best experience possible for people who may have difficulty viewing or listening. If you submit a video that, for example, contains permissible nudity, sexuality or other adult themes, you must rate it as “Mature.” Please read our <a href="https://vimeo.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/224818087-Content-ratings#:~:text=Content%20ratings%20are%20a%20way,next%20to%20their%20video%20title." target="_blank" rel="nofollow noopener noreferrer"><strong>Content Rating</strong></a> guidance for more information.</p><h3 id="ai_generated_content_label_vimeo_com_only">1.8 AI-Generated Content Label (Vimeo.com only)</h3><p>For Vimeo.com only: You must label content that has been meaningfully altered or synthetically generated when it appears to be realistic. Please read our <a href="https://help.vimeo.com/hc/en-us/articles/25551485186833" rel="nofollow">AI Content Label</a> guidance for more information.</p></div></section><section class="otnotice-section" id="otnotice-section-47a74de1-bc97-443e-8846-0164ec166ab7"><div class="otnotice-section-content"><h2 id="restricted_users">2. Restricted Users</h2><p>Certain users may not use our services, regardless of their content. These are: gangs, hate groups, terror organizations, members of the foregoing, and persons who are subject to U.S. sanctions. In certain cases, persons who are subject to sanctions by a non-U.S. government may also be included in this category. In addition, if you are in a country or region that is subject to comprehensive U.S. sanctions, you may not purchase software services or hardware from us. <a> Read More</a><div style="border: 1px solid black; background-color: rgb(255, 242, 204); padding: 10px; display: none;"><h3 id="banned_groups">Banned Groups</h3><p>We define hate groups as organizations that have adopted, based upon its statements, leaders or activities, a hateful ideology. We define a hateful ideology as a set of beliefs that malign a group based upon personal characteristics. For U.S.-based groups, we consider the Southern Poverty Law Center’s designations of hate groups to be conclusive. For non-U.S. groups, we may consider governmental or non-governmental designations. The absence of a group from any list of designated hate groups will not be considered evidence that the group is not a hate group.</p><p>We define a terror group as a group that seeks to use criminal acts intended or calculated to provoke a state of terror in the general public to achieve political or ideological goals. We deem the U.S. Federal Bureau of Investigation’s list of domestic terror groups and the U.S. Department of State’s list of foreign terror groups as conclusive, but not exhaustive. </p><p>A gang means any organization that uses fear, intimidation, or violence to conduct or further illegal activities or goals. We may consult relevant national and foreign law enforcement lists to determine whether an entity constitutes a gang.</p></div></p></div></section><section class="otnotice-section" id="otnotice-section-14afc707-5c3e-4e5c-8cfe-2cc40222833a"><div class="otnotice-section-content"><h2 id="conduct ">3. Conduct </h2><p>Our Code of Conduct, Section 5.3 of our Terms of Service, sets rules that bar users from (among other things) harassing other users, interfering with our technical measures, spamming, or engaging in inauthentic behavior. “Spamming” includes mass distribution of the same or similar content, content containing links intended to sell the user some dubious item, and the use of bots, scripts, or other automated tools for any purpose. “Inauthentic behavior” includes creating fake accounts, liking or commenting on your own content using another account, and purchasing likes or comments from third-parties</p></div></section><section class="otnotice-section" id="otnotice-section-1bf013ac-6782-47ce-b90f-8ad21b53c7fa"><div class="otnotice-section-content"><h2 id="reporting_suspected_violations">4. Reporting Suspected Violations</h2><p>If you see conduct that violates our terms, you may report it by either flagging it (where provided) or <a href="https://vimeo.com/help/contact" target="_blank" rel="nofollow noopener noreferrer">contact us</a>. For Vimeo.com, please read our <a href="https://vimeo.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/224969908-Reporting-abuse-and-violations" target="_blank" rel="nofollow noopener noreferrer"><strong>Reporting Abuse</strong></a> article for more information.</p><p>If you believe that someone has infringed your copyright, please submit a takedown notice using our <a href="https://vimeo.com/dmca" target="_blank" rel="nofollow noopener noreferrer"><strong>Copyright Policy</strong></a>. If you are a law enforcement agency seeking information pertaining to a criminal investigation, please consult our <a href="https://vimeo.com/leo/guidelines" target="_blank" rel="nofollow noopener noreferrer"><strong>Law Enforcement Guidelines</strong></a>. </p></div></section><section class="otnotice-section" id="otnotice-section-d72a9c69-3ac1-4d10-96f3-e8f551b61658"><div class="otnotice-section-content"><h2 id="enforcement">5. Enforcement</h2><h3 id="approach_to_moderation ">5.1 Approach to Moderation </h3><p>We endeavor to review specific content that is flagged by our users, third parties, and certain software-based systems. We do not endeavor to review every piece of content uploaded to our systems. In addition, when we do review content, it is usually for a particular reason, and so we do not endeavor to review it for all possible terms violations. Nor do we “pre-clear” any content before submission. </p><h3 id="suspensions_removals_and_terminations">5.2 Suspensions, removals and terminations</h3><p>Violations may result in suspension or removal of videos, account privileges, or your entire account. Account removal will occur in severe cases, such as where you have wilfully or repeatedly violated our terms or have uploaded extremely inappropriate content. If your account is permanently removed, you may not create a new account.</p><p>We endeavor to notify account holders of our enforcement decisions by emailing the registered email addresses on file. For this reason, it is important that you keep the email addresses up to date and regularly check your email.</p><p>We may, where appropriate, grant grace periods to comply with our requirements. The failure to address our concerns within the provided timeframe will be considered a violation itself absent good cause. </p><h3 id="appeals">5.3 Appeals</h3><p>If you believe that we have made a mistake in moderating your account, you may submit a request to reconsider our decision. <a> Read More</a><div style="border: 1px solid black; background-color: rgb(255, 242, 204); padding: 10px; display: none;"><p>If your appeal concerns a removal due to a copyright infringement claim, please follow the counter-notice procedures in our <a href="https://vimeo.com/dmca" target="_blank" rel="nofollow noopener noreferrer"><strong>Copyright Policy</strong></a>. For all other issues, please follow the procedures below.</p><p>To appeal, complete the <a href="https://vimeo.com/help/contact" rel="nofollow">Appeals Form</a>. In the Form you should (1) identify the content that was removed (and the URL if you have it); (2) provide an explanation of why you believe our decision is in error. Note that arguments such as “I see other people uploading this content” are never considered good excuses. </p><p>Where practicable, we will endeavor to provide a response within 30 days. If we ask for additional information, please provide it promptly. Your failure to do so may result in denial of your appeal. </p><p>If we find good cause to reverse our initial decision, we will either restore the materials (if we still have them) or allow you to resubmit them. Do not re-upload materials pending an appeal. </p><p>Appeals should be filed promptly. We reserve the right to summarily deny appeals that are made 30 days after the removal of content and 60 days after the removal of your account. We also reserve the right not to allow appeals in cases of extreme content, such as CSAM. </p></div></p></div></section><section class="otnotice-section" id="otnotice-section-8533b048-15ad-4f19-a1e1-82dc8cdcfa60"><div class="otnotice-section-content"><h2 id="legal_effect">6. Legal Effect</h2><p>These Guidelines provide our definitive views on our restrictions, but are not meant to be exhaustive and shall not be construed to impose limitations or obligations on Vimeo that do not appear in our Terms of Service. We may, from time to time, update our Guidelines to provide guidance on new situations that may arise.</p></div></section></div><div class="otnotice-version"></div></div></div>    </div>

<script>
      
  // Function to set a cookie with an expiration time
function setCookie(name, value, hours) {
    const expires = new Date();
    expires.setTime(expires.getTime() + (hours * 60 * 60 * 1000));
    document.cookie = `${name}=${value};expires=${expires.toUTCString()};path=/`;
}

// Function to get a cookie value
function getCookie(name) {
    const nameEQ = name + "=";
    const ca = document.cookie.split(';');
    for (let i = 0; i < ca.length; i++) {
        let c = ca[i];
        while (c.charAt(0) === ' ') c = c.substring(1, c.length);
        if (c.indexOf(nameEQ) === 0) return c.substring(nameEQ.length, c.length);
    }
    return null;
}

// Function to delete a cookie
function eraseCookie(name) {
    document.cookie = name + '=; Max-Age=-99999999;';
}

// Function to fetch the help center integration token
async function fetchHCIntegrationToken() {
    try {
        const response = await fetch('/api/v2/help_center/integration/token.json');
        if (!response.ok) throw new Error('Network response was not ok to get hc integration token.');
        const data = await response.json();
        return data.token;
    } catch (error) {
        console.error('Failed to fetch help center integration token:', error);
    }
}
                                          
// Function to request a new JWT token using the hc integration token and additional data
async function fetchJwtToken(bearerToken) {

    const postData = {
  	    userName: '',
        subdomain: 'vimeosupport' // Include subdomain in request data
    };

    try {
        const response = await fetch('https://us-central1-vimeo-infra.cloudfunctions.net/zendesk_messenger_login', {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: {
                'Authorization': `Bearer ${bearerToken}`,
                'Content-Type': 'application/json'
            },
            body: JSON.stringify(postData)
        });
        if (!response.ok) throw new Error('Network response was not ok to create jwt token.');
        const data = await response.json();
        return data.jwtToken;
    } catch (error) {
        console.error('Failed to fetch JWT token:', error);
    }
}

// Function to fetch and set the JWT token
async function fetchAndSetJwtToken() {
    try {
        const hc_integrationToken = await fetchHCIntegrationToken();

        if (hc_integrationToken) {
            const jwtToken = await fetchJwtToken(hc_integrationToken);

            if (jwtToken) {
                setCookie('messenger', jwtToken, 1); // Store the token for 1 hour
                return jwtToken; // Return the new JWT token
            }
        }
    } catch (error) {
        console.error('Failed to fetch and set JWT token:', error);
    }
}

// Function to initialize JWT token management
async function initializeJwtToken() {
    let jwtToken = getCookie('messenger');
    if (!jwtToken) {
        jwtToken = await fetchAndSetJwtToken(); // Fetch and set the token if not present
    }

    // Use the token in the zE function
    zE('messenger', 'loginUser', function (callback) {
        callback(jwtToken);
    });

    // Refresh the JWT token every 55 minutes
    setInterval(async () => {
        jwtToken = await fetchAndSetJwtToken(); // Fetch and set the new token
    }, 55 * 60 * 1000); // Refresh every 55 minutes
}

function detectBrowser() {
  const userAgent = navigator.userAgent;
  let browserName = "Unknown";
  let browserVersion = "Unknown";
  
  // Detect Chrome
  if (/Chrome/.test(userAgent) && !/Chromium|Edge|Edg|OPR|Opera|Brave|Vivaldi/.test(userAgent)) {
    browserName = "Chrome";
    const match = userAgent.match(/Chrome\/(\d+\.\d+\.\d+\.\d+)/);
    browserVersion = match ? match[1] : "Unknown";
  }
  // Detect Firefox
  else if (/Firefox/.test(userAgent) && !/Seamonkey/.test(userAgent)) {
    browserName = "Firefox";
    const match = userAgent.match(/Firefox\/(\d+\.\d+)/);
    browserVersion = match ? match[1] : "Unknown";
  }
  // Detect Safari (only for macOS as iOS Safari has different UA)
  else if (/Safari/.test(userAgent) && !/Chrome|Chromium|Edge|Edg|OPR|Opera/.test(userAgent)) {
    browserName = "Safari";
    const match = userAgent.match(/Version\/(\d+\.\d+\.\d+)/);
    browserVersion = match ? match[1] : "Unknown";
  }
  // Detect Edge (Chromium-based)
  else if (/Edg/.test(userAgent)) {
    browserName = "Edge";
    const match = userAgent.match(/Edg\/(\d+\.\d+\.\d+\.\d+)/);
    browserVersion = match ? match[1] : "Unknown";
  }
  // Detect Opera
  else if (/OPR|Opera/.test(userAgent)) {
    browserName = "Opera";
    const match = userAgent.match(/(?:OPR|Opera)\/(\d+\.\d+\.\d+)/);
    browserVersion = match ? match[1] : "Unknown";
  }
  // Detect IE
  else if (/MSIE|Trident/.test(userAgent)) {
    browserName = "Internet Explorer";
    const match = userAgent.match(/(?:MSIE |rv:)(\d+\.\d+)/);
    browserVersion = match ? match[1] : "Unknown";
  }
  
  return {
    name: browserName,
    version: browserVersion
  };
}
function extractPlatformFromUA(userAgentString) {
    // Basic input validation
    if (!userAgentString || typeof userAgentString !== 'string') {
      console.error("Invalid input: userAgentString must be a non-empty string.");
      return null;
    }
    const regex = /\((.*?)\)/;

    const match = userAgentString.match(regex);
    if (match && match[1]) {
      return match[1]; // Return the captured platform string
    } else {
      // Pattern not found
      console.warn("Could not find platform information within parentheses in the UA string:", userAgentString);
      return null;
    }
  }

        <h1 title="How do I label my videos to indicate they contain AI-generated content?" class="article-title">
          How do I label my videos to indicate they contain AI-generated content?
          
        </h1>

        <!--<div class="article-author">
          
          <div class="article-meta">
            

            <ul class="meta-group">
              
                <li class="meta-data"><time datetime="2025-02-26T02:34:05Z" title="2025-02-26T02:34:05Z" data-datetime="relative">February 26, 2025 02:34</time></li>

      <section class="article-info">
        <div class="article-content">
          <div class="article-body"><p>To strike a balance between creators’ innovative use of artificial intelligence (AI) tools and the demand from viewers for transparency regarding the authenticity of the content they consume, we require creators to disclose when realistic videos are made with altered or synthetic media, including generative AI.<br><br><span style="color: #1f1f1f;" data-darkreader-inline-color="">Labeling a video containing AI-generated content won’t limit a video’s audience.</span></p>
<p><strong>In this article: </strong></p>
<ul>
<li><a href="#h_01J211ZKDHEZN8KAYXKNBXFHYG">When to label content as AI-generated</a></li>
<li><a href="#h_01J211BDSG5E5GDW8XB3W674D8">How to disclose AI-generated content</a></li>
<li><a href="#h_01J211BDSGSFQHWEHAW7E1Z0JK">Where the AI-generated label will appear</a></li>
<li><a href="#h_01J211BDSGASKRXZX9FFSH0RQY">About Automated labeling</a></li>
<li><a href="#h_01J211BDSGTNVCJEBNYT8ZYZF0">Risks of not disclosing</a></li>
<li><a href="#h_01J211BDSG3XV37VG3EDGAV2Z3">Violations of the AI-generated disclosure policy</a></li>
</ul>
<h3 id="h_01J211ZKDHEZN8KAYXKNBXFHYG"><span style="color: #434343;" data-darkreader-inline-color="">When to label content as AI-Generated</span></h3>
<p>In general, Creators must label content that:</p>
<ul>
<li><span style="color: #1f1f1f;" data-darkreader-inline-color="">Portrays a real person saying or doing something they didn't.</span></li>
<li><span style="color: #1f1f1f;" data-darkreader-inline-color="">Alters footage of an actual event or location.</span></li>
<li><span style="color: #1f1f1f;" data-darkreader-inline-color="">Creates a lifelike scene that didn’t take place.</span></li>
</ul>
<p><span style="color: #1f1f1f;" data-darkreader-inline-color="">This includes content that creators have partially or entirely altered or created using audio, video, or image creation or editing tools.</span></p>
<p><span style="color: #1f1f1f;" data-darkreader-inline-color="">Realistic content and meaningful changes require disclosure, while unrealistic or minor edits don’t.  Minor edits are primarily aesthetic and don't alter the content in a way that could mislead the viewer about what actually happened. Below are some examples of altered or synthetic content that may or may not require disclosure by creators.  This list isn’t exhaustive.</span></p>
<p><strong><span style="color: #1f1f1f;" data-darkreader-inline-color="">Examples of content requiring disclosure include:</span></strong></p>
<ul>
<li><span style="color: #1f1f1f;" data-darkreader-inline-color="">Manipulated footage of a politician to make it seem like they made a controversial statement they didn’t actually say</span></li>
<li><span style="color: #1f1f1f;" data-darkreader-inline-color="">Edited footage of a natural disaster to make it appear more severe than it actually was</span></li>
<li><span style="color: #1f1f1f;" data-darkreader-inline-color="">A lifelike depiction of a famous historical event that didn’t occur</span></li>
<li><span style="color: #1f1f1f;" data-darkreader-inline-color="">Cloned voices used for a voiceover</span></li>
</ul>
<p><span style="color: #1f1f1f;" data-darkreader-inline-color="">We don’t require creators to disclose content that is clearly unrealistic, animated, includes special effects, or uses generative AI for production assistance only.</span></p>
<p><strong><span style="color: #1f1f1f;" data-darkreader-inline-color="">Examples of content not requiring disclosure include:</span></strong></p>
<ul>
<li><span style="color: #1f1f1f;" data-darkreader-inline-color="">Animation featuring fictional characters in a fantasy setting</span></li>
<li><span style="color: #1f1f1f;" data-darkreader-inline-color="">Obvious special effects showing a person flying through the air</span></li>
<li><span style="color: #1f1f1f;" data-darkreader-inline-color="">Documentary showcasing real interviews and events without any alterations</span></li>
<li><span style="color: #1f1f1f;" data-darkreader-inline-color="">Beauty filters</span></li>
<li><span style="color: #1f1f1f;" data-darkreader-inline-color="">Enhanced audio to remove background noise and improve clarity</span></li>
</ul>
<h3 id="h_01J211BDSG5E5GDW8XB3W674D8">How do I disclose AI-generated content in my video?</h3>
<p><span style="color: #1f1f1f;" data-darkreader-inline-color="">You can disclose videos that have been meaningfully altered or synthetically generated while you are uploading them or at a later time from the video settings page.</span></p>
<p><strong><span style="color: #1f1f1f;" data-darkreader-inline-color="">To disclose AI-generated content in your video: </span></strong></p>
<ol>
<li><span style="color: #1f1f1f;" data-darkreader-inline-color="">Select your video from the <strong><a href="/hc/en-us/articles/19832457988625" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Library</a></strong> to open the video settings page.</span></li>
<li>
<span style="color: #1f1f1f;" data-darkreader-inline-color="">Scroll past the player to the </span><strong><span style="color: #1f1f1f;" data-darkreader-inline-color="">Content</span></strong><span style="color: #1f1f1f;" data-darkreader-inline-color=""> section. </span><span style="color: #1f1f1f;" data-darkreader-inline-color=""><br></span><img src="/hc/article_attachments/26476999587601" width="597" height="214">
</li>
<li>
<span style="color: #1f1f1f;" data-darkreader-inline-color="">Select the checkbox for </span><strong><span style="color: #1f1f1f;" data-darkreader-inline-color="">AI-generated content</span></strong><span style="color: #1f1f1f;" data-darkreader-inline-color="">.</span>
</li>
<li>
<span style="color: #1f1f1f;" data-darkreader-inline-color="">Select the checkbox for </span><strong><span style="color: #1f1f1f;" data-darkreader-inline-color="">Audio</span></strong><span style="color: #1f1f1f;" data-darkreader-inline-color=""> or </span><strong><span style="color: #1f1f1f;" data-darkreader-inline-color="">Visuals</span></strong><span style="color: #1f1f1f;" data-darkreader-inline-color="">, or both. </span>
</li>
</ol>
<h3 id="h_01J211BDSGSFQHWEHAW7E1Z0JK">Where will the AI-generated label appear in my video?</h3>
<p><span style="color: #1f1f1f;" data-darkreader-inline-color="">The label can be found on the video page and embeddable video player. The label will be expanded to other Vimeo surfaces in the future.</span></p>
<p><span style="color: #1f1f1f;" data-darkreader-inline-color="">After you disclose content that has been </span>meaningfully altered or synthetically generated,<span style="color: #1f1f1f;" data-darkreader-inline-color=""> a label will appear on the video page:</span></p>
<p class="wysiwyg-text-align-left"><img src="/hc/article_attachments/26477014687505" width="494" height="210"></p>
<p><span style="color: #1f1f1f;" data-darkreader-inline-color="">On embedded videos, a label will appear in the video player:</span></p>
<p class="wysiwyg-text-align-left"><span style="color: #1f1f1f;" data-darkreader-inline-color=""><img src="/hc/article_attachments/26477014689041" width="597" height="355"></span></p>
<h3 id="h_01J211BDSGASKRXZX9FFSH0RQY">Automated labeling of AI-generated content</h3>
<p><span style="color: #1f1f1f;" data-darkreader-inline-color="">If a creator makes a video using one of </span><a href="https://help.vimeo.com/hc/en-us/sections/22088938600337-Vimeo-AI" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Vimeo’s AI</a><span style="color: #1f1f1f;" data-darkreader-inline-color=""> tools, we’ll automatically apply a label disclosing the use.</span></p>
<h3 id="h_01J211BDSGTNVCJEBNYT8ZYZF0">Risks of not disclosing</h3>
<p><span style="color: #1f1f1f;" data-darkreader-inline-color="">Failing to reveal altered or synthetic content carries various risks, including misleading viewers and undermining their trust in creators.  It can also result in legal repercussions and raise ethical concerns about manipulation and exploitation.  Moreover, it can have adverse psychological and social effects on audiences.</span></p>
<p><span style="color: #1f1f1f;" data-darkreader-inline-color="">Non-disclosure may lead to misunderstandings, legal disputes, and erosion of trust between creators and their audience.  Additionally, it can contribute to the spread of fake news and undermine public discourse.  Compliance with regulatory requirements and ethical standards is essential to mitigate these risks and maintain integrity in media creation and consumption.  Transparency in disclosing altered or synthetic content is crucial to upholding trust, integrity, and responsible media practices.</span></p>
<h3 id="h_01J211BDSG3XV37VG3EDGAV2Z3">Violations of the AI-generated disclosure policy</h3>
<p><span style="color: #1f1f1f;" data-darkreader-inline-color="">When meaningfully altered or synthetically generated content is undisclosed, Vimeo may, in appropriate cases, take action to reduce the risk of harm to viewers by proactively applying a label that creators will not have the option to remove.  For high-severity violations, such as misleading information that creates a serious risk of material harm to a person, group, or the general public, we may remove the content entirely.</span></p>
<p><span style="color: #1f1f1f;" data-darkreader-inline-color="">Creators who consistently choose not to disclose this information may be subject to penalties from Vimeo, including removal of content or account termination.</span></p>
<p><span style="color: #1f1f1f;" data-darkreader-inline-color="">If you believe that your content was labeled or removed, or your account was terminated in error, you can submit an appeal.  See our </span><a href="https://vimeo.com/help/guidelines" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Community Guidelines</a><span style="color: #1f1f1f;" data-darkreader-inline-color=""> for additional information regarding appeals.</span></p></div>
          
        </div>

  // Function to set a cookie with an expiration time
function setCookie(name, value, hours) {
    const expires = new Date();
    expires.setTime(expires.getTime() + (hours * 60 * 60 * 1000));
    document.cookie = `${name}=${value};expires=${expires.toUTCString()};path=/`;
}

// Function to get a cookie value
function getCookie(name) {
    const nameEQ = name + "=";
    const ca = document.cookie.split(';');
    for (let i = 0; i < ca.length; i++) {
        let c = ca[i];
        while (c.charAt(0) === ' ') c = c.substring(1, c.length);
        if (c.indexOf(nameEQ) === 0) return c.substring(nameEQ.length, c.length);
    }
    return null;
}

// Function to delete a cookie
function eraseCookie(name) {
    document.cookie = name + '=; Max-Age=-99999999;';
}

// Function to fetch the help center integration token
async function fetchHCIntegrationToken() {
    try {
        const response = await fetch('/api/v2/help_center/integration/token.json');
        if (!response.ok) throw new Error('Network response was not ok to get hc integration token.');
        const data = await response.json();
        return data.token;
    } catch (error) {
        console.error('Failed to fetch help center integration token:', error);
    }
}
                                          
// Function to request a new JWT token using the hc integration token and additional data
async function fetchJwtToken(bearerToken) {

    const postData = {
  	    userName: '',
        subdomain: 'vimeosupport' // Include subdomain in request data
    };

    try {
        const response = await fetch('https://us-central1-vimeo-infra.cloudfunctions.net/zendesk_messenger_login', {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: {
                'Authorization': `Bearer ${bearerToken}`,
                'Content-Type': 'application/json'
            },
            body: JSON.stringify(postData)
        });
        if (!response.ok) throw new Error('Network response was not ok to create jwt token.');
        const data = await response.json();
        return data.jwtToken;
    } catch (error) {
        console.error('Failed to fetch JWT token:', error);
    }
}

// Function to fetch and set the JWT token
async function fetchAndSetJwtToken() {
    try {
        const hc_integrationToken = await fetchHCIntegrationToken();

        if (hc_integrationToken) {
            const jwtToken = await fetchJwtToken(hc_integrationToken);

            if (jwtToken) {
                setCookie('messenger', jwtToken, 1); // Store the token for 1 hour
                return jwtToken; // Return the new JWT token
            }
        }
    } catch (error) {
        console.error('Failed to fetch and set JWT token:', error);
    }
}

// Function to initialize JWT token management
async function initializeJwtToken() {
    let jwtToken = getCookie('messenger');
    if (!jwtToken) {
        jwtToken = await fetchAndSetJwtToken(); // Fetch and set the token if not present
    }

    // Use the token in the zE function
    zE('messenger', 'loginUser', function (callback) {
        callback(jwtToken);
    });

    // Refresh the JWT token every 55 minutes
    setInterval(async () => {
        jwtToken = await fetchAndSetJwtToken(); // Fetch and set the new token
    }, 55 * 60 * 1000); // Refresh every 55 minutes
}

function detectBrowser() {
  const userAgent = navigator.userAgent;
  let browserName = "Unknown";
  let browserVersion = "Unknown";
  
  // Detect Chrome
  if (/Chrome/.test(userAgent) && !/Chromium|Edge|Edg|OPR|Opera|Brave|Vivaldi/.test(userAgent)) {
    browserName = "Chrome";
    const match = userAgent.match(/Chrome\/(\d+\.\d+\.\d+\.\d+)/);
    browserVersion = match ? match[1] : "Unknown";
  }
  // Detect Firefox
  else if (/Firefox/.test(userAgent) && !/Seamonkey/.test(userAgent)) {
    browserName = "Firefox";
    const match = userAgent.match(/Firefox\/(\d+\.\d+)/);
    browserVersion = match ? match[1] : "Unknown";
  }
  // Detect Safari (only for macOS as iOS Safari has different UA)
  else if (/Safari/.test(userAgent) && !/Chrome|Chromium|Edge|Edg|OPR|Opera/.test(userAgent)) {
    browserName = "Safari";
    const match = userAgent.match(/Version\/(\d+\.\d+\.\d+)/);
    browserVersion = match ? match[1] : "Unknown";
  }
  // Detect Edge (Chromium-based)
  else if (/Edg/.test(userAgent)) {
    browserName = "Edge";
    const match = userAgent.match(/Edg\/(\d+\.\d+\.\d+\.\d+)/);
    browserVersion = match ? match[1] : "Unknown";
  }
  // Detect Opera
  else if (/OPR|Opera/.test(userAgent)) {
    browserName = "Opera";
    const match = userAgent.match(/(?:OPR|Opera)\/(\d+\.\d+\.\d+)/);
    browserVersion = match ? match[1] : "Unknown";
  }
  // Detect IE
  else if (/MSIE|Trident/.test(userAgent)) {
    browserName = "Internet Explorer";
    const match = userAgent.match(/(?:MSIE |rv:)(\d+\.\d+)/);
    browserVersion = match ? match[1] : "Unknown";
  }
  
  return {
    name: browserName,
    version: browserVersion
  };
}
function extractPlatformFromUA(userAgentString) {
    // Basic input validation
    if (!userAgentString || typeof userAgentString !== 'string') {
      console.error("Invalid input: userAgentString must be a non-empty string.");
      return null;
    }
    const regex = /\((.*?)\)/;

    const match = userAgentString.match(regex);
    if (match && match[1]) {
      return match[1]; // Return the captured platform string
    } else {
      // Pattern not found
      console.warn("Could not find platform information within parentheses in the UA string:", userAgentString);
      return null;
    }
  }

          How can I tell if a video on Vimeo was generated with or enhanced by using AI?
          
        </h1>

        <!--<div class="article-author">

            <ul class="meta-group">

      <section class="article-info">
        <div class="article-content">
          <div class="article-body"><p><span style="color: #0a0e12;">To balance creators’ innovative use of artificial intelligence (AI) tools and viewers’ demands for transparency regarding the authenticity of the content they consume, we require creators to disclose when they use altered or synthetic media, including generative AI, in realistic videos. Learn more at </span><a href="https://help.vimeo.com/hc/en-us/articles/25551485186833-How-do-I-label-my-videos-to-indicate-they-contain-AI-generated-content"><span class="wysiwyg-underline" style="color: #1155cc;">How do I label my videos to indicate they contain AI-generated content?</span></a><span style="color: #0a0e12;"> </span></p>
<p><span style="color: #1f1f1f;">After a creator discloses content that has been </span><span style="color: #0a0e12;">meaningfully altered or synthetically generated,</span><span style="color: #1f1f1f;"> a label will appear on the video page:</span></p>
<p><span style="color: #1f1f1f;"><img src="/hc/article_attachments/35085554190225" width="495" height="211"></span></p>
<p><span style="color: #1f1f1f;">On embedded videos, a label will appear in the video player:</span></p>
<p><span style="color: #1f1f1f;"><img src="/hc/article_attachments/35085555822737" width="599" height="356"></span></p>
<p><strong><span style="color: #1f1f1f;">⚠️Note: </span></strong><span style="color: #1f1f1f;">If a creator disables the display of their video's title in an embedded player, the message stating that the footage contains AI content will not appear.</span></p></div>
          
        </div>

builder-id="builder-1aa9e082efef43f6bb9ee6283689ee77" class="builder-1aa9e082efef43f6bb9ee6283689ee77 builder-block"><div class="builder-text" style="outline: none;"><p>To the Vimeo community:</p><p>Last month, I shared some thoughts on <a href="https://vimeo.com/blog/post/note-on-ai/" data-id="0-builder-81bd335959c5445b8c4999132c35c791">Vimeo, AI, and the future</a> and asked for your feedback. It's been incredibly helpful to hear from so many of you as we navigate the evolving landscape of technology and creativity together.</p><p>As we integrate AI tools into Vimeo, our goal is to uplift and protect the creator and their creative process. Gathering this feedback ensured that our community’s voice guided our decisions and that we approached this question with transparency and inclusion.</p><p>After extensive outreach and hearing your thoughts, we are taking a definitive stance contrary to many other community websites: <strong>Vimeo will not allow generative AI models to be trained using videos hosted on our platform without your explicit consent, even if you use our free offerings.</strong> In addition, we prohibit unauthorized content scraping (by model companies) and continue to implement security protocols designed to protect user-generated content.</p><p>This decision underscores our role as a protector of creative rights and reflects our dedication to the ethical and transparent use of technology.</p><p>Many of you expressed concerns about your content's potential misuse and its implications on your creative rights. Your feedback has been invaluable. We understand that your trust is fundamental to our relationship, and we are committed to preserving that trust.</p><p>Here are some key points that shaped our decision:</p><p><strong>Protecting creative rights</strong>: We recognize the unique value of your creative work. By committing not to use your videos to train generative AI models, we aim to safeguard your creative voice and ensure that your content remains under your control. </p><p><strong>Transparency and control</strong>: While AI offers many benefits, it is crucial that you, our creators, have a clear and transparent understanding of when AI is being used, and you want control over how your content is used. This decision aligns with our principles of providing transparency and equipping you with control.</p><p><strong>Community feedback</strong>: Your insights and feedback have been central to this decision. We are committed to supporting our creators who do and do not want to use AI in their creative process. We will continue this dialogue and ensure that your perspectives shape our policies and practices.</p><p>Moving forward, you should expect us to release many new services to assist creators in their creative process, their discoverability and even managing their rights. As we create these new experiences for you, our dedication to transparency and protecting your work remains unwavering. </p><p>Thank you for being an essential part of the Vimeo community. Together, we will continue to harness the power of technology to tell stories that inspire, entertain, and connect us.</p><hr class="blog-spacer"><p><em>Please note that this blog post contains forward-looking statements. For additional information and considerations, <a href="https://investors.vimeo.com/safe-harbor-statement" data-id="1-builder-81bd335959c5445b8c4999132c35c791">click here</a>. </em></p></div></div></div></div><aside class="w-full p-8 md:w-[288px] md:p-0 relative"><div class="[&>.builder-blocks]:flex [&>.builder-blocks]:flex-col [&>.builder-blocks]:gap-8 md:sticky md:top-[110px] md:left-0 md:right-0"><style>.props-blocks-wrapper-8834791c {

your feedback. It's been incredibly helpful to hear from so many of you as we navigate the evolving landscape of technology and creativity together.\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003eAs we integrate AI tools into Vimeo, our goal is to uplift and protect the creator and their creative process. Gathering this feedback ensured that our community’s voice guided our decisions and that we approached this question with transparency and inclusion.\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003eAfter extensive outreach and hearing your thoughts, we are taking a definitive stance contrary to many other community websites: \u003cstrong\u003eVimeo will not allow generative AI models to be trained using videos hosted on our platform without your explicit consent, even if you use our free offerings.\u003c/strong\u003e In addition, we prohibit unauthorized content scraping (by model companies) and continue to implement security protocols designed to protect user-generated content.\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003eThis decision underscores our role as a protector of creative rights and reflects our dedication to the ethical and transparent use of technology.\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003eMany of you expressed concerns about your content's potential misuse and its implications on your creative rights. Your feedback has been invaluable. We understand that your trust is fundamental to our relationship, and we are committed to preserving that trust.\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003eHere are some key points that shaped our decision:\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eProtecting creative rights\u003c/strong\u003e: We recognize the unique value of your creative work. By committing not to use your videos to train generative AI models, we aim to safeguard your creative voice and ensure that your content remains under your control.\u0026nbsp;\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eTransparency and control\u003c/strong\u003e: While AI offers many benefits, it is crucial that you, our creators, have a clear and transparent understanding of when AI is being used, and you want control over how your content is used. This decision aligns with our principles of providing transparency and equipping you with control.\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eCommunity feedback\u003c/strong\u003e: Your insights and feedback have been central to this decision. We are committed to supporting our creators who do and do not want to use AI in their creative process. We will continue this dialogue and ensure that your perspectives shape our policies and practices.\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003eMoving forward, you should expect us to release many new services to assist creators in their creative process, their discoverability and even managing their rights. As we create these new experiences for you, our dedication to transparency and protecting your work remains unwavering.\u0026nbsp;\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003eThank you for being an essential part of the Vimeo community. your feedback. It's been incredibly helpful to hear from so many of you as we navigate the evolving landscape of technology and creativity together.\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003eAs we integrate AI tools into Vimeo, our goal is to uplift and protect the creator and their creative process. Gathering this feedback ensured that our community’s voice guided our decisions and that we approached this question with transparency and inclusion.\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003eAfter extensive outreach and hearing your thoughts, we are taking a definitive stance contrary to many other community websites: \u003cstrong\u003eVimeo will not allow generative AI models to be trained using videos hosted on our platform without your explicit consent, even if you use our free offerings.\u003c/strong\u003e In addition, we prohibit unauthorized content scraping (by model companies) and continue to implement security protocols designed to protect user-generated content.\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003eThis decision underscores our role as a protector of creative rights and reflects our dedication to the ethical and transparent use of technology.\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003eMany of you expressed concerns about your content's potential misuse and its implications on your creative rights. Your feedback has been invaluable. We understand that your trust is fundamental to our relationship, and we are committed to preserving that trust.\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003eHere are some key points that shaped our decision:\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eProtecting creative rights\u003c/strong\u003e: We recognize the unique value of your creative work. By committing not to use your videos to train generative AI models, we aim to safeguard your creative voice and ensure that your content remains under your control.\u0026nbsp;\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eTransparency and control\u003c/strong\u003e: While AI offers many benefits, it is crucial that you, our creators, have a clear and transparent understanding of when AI is being used, and you want control over how your content is used. This decision aligns with our principles of providing transparency and equipping you with control.\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eCommunity feedback\u003c/strong\u003e: Your insights and feedback have been central to this decision. We are committed to supporting our creators who do and do not want to use AI in their creative process. We will continue this dialogue and ensure that your perspectives shape our policies and practices.\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003eMoving forward, you should expect us to release many new services to assist creators in their creative process, their discoverability and even managing their rights. Many great filmmakers tell us time and time again how the genuineness of our human-curated \u003ca href=\"https://vimeo.com/channels/staffpicks?rv=true\"\u003eVimeo Staff Picks\u003c/a\u003e encouraged them to get started or to keep going.\u0026nbsp;\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003eAs algorithms and generative AIs reshape video content, there are many wonderful opportunities to accelerate storytelling. However, we hear your concerns about authenticity. At Vimeo, we aspire to be a place that celebrates and protects the creator with transparency and trust, and have already begun \u003ca href=\"https://vimeo.com/blog/post/vimeos-position-on-ai/\"\u003etaking proactive measures\u003c/a\u003e to ensure Vimeo remains a platform where creators and viewers alike can understand the origins of the content they encounter.\u0026nbsp;\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003eToday, we're going even further in announcing important updates to our \u003ca href=\"https://vimeo.com/terms\"\u003eTerms of Service\u003c/a\u003e and \u003ca href=\"https://vimeo.com/help/guidelines\"\u003eCommunity Guidelines\u003c/a\u003e, which ask creators to label AI-generated, synthetically-generated, or other meaningfully manipulated content that could be mistaken for real people, places, or events. We’re very supportive of using AI in the creative process — we've already seen our community experiment with the tool in ways we're excited to showcase. But this new policy reflects the growing global interest in transparency in the use of AI.\u0026nbsp;\u003c/p\u003e\u003ch3\u003eWhy AI labeling matters\u003c/h3\u003e\u003cp\u003eThe rise of deepfakes and other AI-generated media has made it increasingly difficult to distinguish between what's real and what's synthetic, which can erode trust, spread misinformation, and have harmful consequences for individuals and society.\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003eBy introducing AI content labeling, we aim to:\u003c/p\u003e\u003cul\u003e\u003cli\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eUphold platform integrity\u003c/strong\u003e: Combat the spread of misinformation, especially deepfakes that can be used to manipulate public opinion.\u003c/li\u003e\u003cli\u003e\u003cstrong\u003ePreserve content authenticity\u003c/strong\u003e: Maintain trust and integrity within the Vimeo community by reducing the risk of viewers being misled by inauthentic video content.\u003c/li\u003e\u003cli\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eEmpower viewers\u003c/strong\u003e: Provide you with information to understand the content you consume.\u0026nbsp;\u003c/li\u003e\u003cli\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eSupport creators\u003c/strong\u003e: Help creators maintain their audience's trust by distinguishing their techniques.\u003c/li\u003e\u003c/ul\u003e\u003ch3\u003eHow it works\u003c/h3\u003e\u003cp\u003eSoon, you'll notice a label on videos indicating that creators have voluntarily disclosed their use of AI. This label will also appear on videos created using \u003ca href=\"https://vimeo.com/features/vimeo-ai\"\u003eVimeo's own AI tools\u003c/a\u003e. This indicator is not our opinion of the content's value — instead, like the ingredients on a food label, it’s for the benefit of our customers to be informed. Our long-term goal is to develop automated labeling systems that can reliably detect AI-generated content, further enhancing transparency and reducing the burden on creators.\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003eWe recommend labeling content that:\u003c/p\u003e\u003cul\u003e\u003cli\u003ePortrays a real person saying or doing something they didn't say or place.\u003c/li\u003e\u003c/ul\u003e\u003cp\u003eThis includes content that has been partially or entirely altered or created using AI-powered audio, video, or image film festival season, and over the past few months, we’ve been excited to see so many Vimeo customers win awards at Cannes, Tribeca, and Sundance. In a world of algorithm-driven video clips, these festivals remind us of the value of human curation. Many great filmmakers tell us time and time again how the genuineness of our human-curated \u003ca href=\"https://vimeo.com/channels/staffpicks?rv=true\"\u003eVimeo Staff Picks\u003c/a\u003e encouraged them to get started or to keep going.\u0026nbsp;\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003eAs algorithms and generative AIs reshape video content, there are many wonderful opportunities to accelerate storytelling. However, we hear your concerns about authenticity. At Vimeo, we aspire to be a place that celebrates and protects the creator with transparency and trust, and have already begun \u003ca href=\"https://vimeo.com/blog/post/vimeos-position-on-ai/\"\u003etaking proactive measures\u003c/a\u003e to ensure Vimeo remains a platform where creators and viewers alike can understand the origins of the content they encounter.\u0026nbsp;\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003eToday, we're going even further in announcing important updates to our \u003ca href=\"https://vimeo.com/terms\"\u003eTerms of Service\u003c/a\u003e and \u003ca href=\"https://vimeo.com/help/guidelines\"\u003eCommunity Guidelines\u003c/a\u003e, which ask creators to label AI-generated, synthetically-generated, or other meaningfully manipulated content that could be mistaken for real people, places, or events. We’re very supportive of using AI in the creative process — we've already seen our community experiment with the tool in ways we're excited to showcase. But this new policy reflects the growing global interest in transparency in the use of AI.\u0026nbsp;\u003c/p\u003e\u003ch3\u003eWhy AI labeling matters\u003c/h3\u003e\u003cp\u003eThe rise of deepfakes and other AI-generated media has made it increasingly difficult to distinguish between what's real and what's synthetic, which can erode trust, spread misinformation, and have harmful consequences for individuals and society.\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003eBy introducing AI content labeling, we aim to:\u003c/p\u003e\u003cul\u003e\u003cli\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eUphold platform integrity\u003c/strong\u003e: Combat the spread of misinformation, especially deepfakes that can be used to manipulate public opinion.\u003c/li\u003e\u003cli\u003e\u003cstrong\u003ePreserve content authenticity\u003c/strong\u003e: Maintain trust and integrity within the Vimeo community by reducing the risk of viewers being misled by inauthentic video content.\u003c/li\u003e\u003cli\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eEmpower viewers\u003c/strong\u003e: Provide you with information to understand the content you consume.\u0026nbsp;\u003c/li\u003e\u003cli\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eSupport creators\u003c/strong\u003e: Help creators maintain their audience's trust by distinguishing their techniques.\u003c/li\u003e\u003c/ul\u003e\u003ch3\u003eHow it works\u003c/h3\u003e\u003cp\u003eSoon, you'll notice a label on videos indicating that creators have voluntarily disclosed their use of AI. This label will also appear on videos created using \u003ca href=\"https://vimeo.com/features/vimeo-ai\"\u003eVimeo's own AI tools\u003c/a\u003e. This indicator is not our opinion of the content's value — instead, like the ingredients on a food label, it’s for the benefit of our customers to be informed. Our long-term goal is to develop automated labeling systems that can reliably detect AI-generated content, further enhancing transparency and reducing the burden on creators.\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003eWe recommend labeling content that:\u003c/p\u003e\u003cul\u003e\u003cli\u003ePortrays a real person saying or doing something they didn't say or do.\u003c/li\u003e\u003cli\u003eAlters footage of an actual event or location.\u003c/li\u003e\u003cli\u003eCreates a lifelike scene that didn’t take place.\u003c/li\u003e\u003c/ul\u003e\u003cp\u003eThis includes content that has been partially or entirely altered or created using AI-powered audio, video, or image As such, creators must label meaningfully manipulated content." aria-hidden="false" loading="lazy" class="progressive-image block w-full max-w-full h-auto object-cover rounded-standard aspect-16/9 transform-gpu will-change-[object-position]"></div></figure></div><div class="flex flex-col px-4 md:p-0 gap-y-12 blog-post-content"><style data-id="builderio-block" nonce="">    </style><div builder-id="builder-213c8eea05de47848b34eb9cc4bf79ed" class="builder-213c8eea05de47848b34eb9cc4bf79ed builder-block"><div class="builder-text" style="outline: none;"><p>It's film festival season, and over the past few months, we’ve been excited to see so many Vimeo customers win awards at Cannes, Tribeca, and Sundance. In a world of algorithm-driven video clips, these festivals remind us of the value of human curation. Many great filmmakers tell us time and time again how the genuineness of our human-curated <a href="https://vimeo.com/channels/staffpicks?rv=true" data-id="0-builder-79976fa3a047402aa270b1f007420c68">Vimeo Staff Picks</a> encouraged them to get started or to keep going. </p><p>As algorithms and generative AIs reshape video content, there are many wonderful opportunities to accelerate storytelling. However, we hear your concerns about authenticity. At Vimeo, we aspire to be a place that celebrates and protects the creator with transparency and trust, and have already begun <a href="https://vimeo.com/blog/post/vimeos-position-on-ai/" data-id="1-builder-79976fa3a047402aa270b1f007420c68">taking proactive measures</a> to ensure Vimeo remains a platform where creators and viewers alike can understand the origins of the content they encounter. </p><p>Today, we're going even further in announcing important updates to our <a href="https://vimeo.com/terms" data-id="2-builder-79976fa3a047402aa270b1f007420c68">Terms of Service</a> and <a href="https://vimeo.com/help/guidelines" data-id="3-builder-79976fa3a047402aa270b1f007420c68">Community Guidelines</a>, which ask creators to label AI-generated, synthetically-generated, or other meaningfully manipulated content that could be mistaken for real people, places, or events. We’re very supportive of using AI in the creative process — we've already seen our community experiment with the tool in ways we're excited to showcase. But this new policy reflects the growing global interest in transparency in the use of AI. </p><h3>Why AI labeling matters</h3><p>The rise of deepfakes and other AI-generated media has made it increasingly difficult to distinguish between what's real and what's synthetic, which can erode trust, spread misinformation, and have harmful consequences for individuals and society.</p><p>By introducing AI content labeling, we aim to:</p><ul><li><strong>Uphold platform integrity</strong>: Combat the spread of misinformation, especially deepfakes that can be used to manipulate public opinion.</li><li><strong>Preserve content authenticity</strong>: Maintain trust and integrity within the Vimeo community by reducing the risk of viewers being misled by inauthentic video content.</li><li><strong>Empower viewers</strong>: Provide you with information to understand the content you consume. </li><li><strong>Support creators</strong>: Help creators maintain their audience's trust by distinguishing their techniques.</li></ul><h3>How it works</h3><p>Soon, you'll notice a label on videos indicating that creators have voluntarily disclosed their use of AI. This label will also appear on videos created using <a href="https://vimeo.com/features/vimeo-ai" data-id="4-builder-79976fa3a047402aa270b1f007420c68">Vimeo's own AI tools</a>. This indicator is not our opinion of the content's value — instead, like the ingredients on a food label, it’s for the benefit of our customers to be informed. Our long-term goal is to develop automated labeling systems that can reliably detect AI-generated content, further enhancing transparency and reducing the burden on creators.</p><p>We recommend labeling content that:</p><ul><li>Portrays a real person saying or doing something they didn't say or do.</li><li>Alters footage of an actual event or location.</li><li>Creates a lifelike scene that didn’t take place.</li></ul><p>This includes content that has been partially or entirely altered or created using AI-powered audio, video, or image tools.</p></div></div><style data-id="builderio-block" nonce="">    </style><div builder-id="builder-cbefb27acb3043749bc743385c30bd85" class="builder-cbefb27acb3043749bc743385c30bd85 builder-block"><figure><div class="asset-image-container relative undefined"><img src="https://f.vimeocdn.com/cms-images/2024/07/In-line-image-1.jpg?w=1024" alt="Close up of Vimeo's UI showing the hover state over an "includes AI" button" title="Close up of Vimeo's UI showing the hover state over an "includes AI" button" aria-hidden="false" loading="lazy" class="progressive-image block w-full max-w-full h-auto object-cover rounded-standard aspect-16/9 transform-gpu will-change-[object-position]"></div></figure></div><style data-id="builderio-block" nonce="">    </style><div builder-id="builder-854d016bfba64b8f9f668f10400bb02e" class="builder-854d016bfba64b8f9f668f10400bb02e builder-block"><div class="builder-text" style="outline: none;"><hr class="blog-spacer"><h3>How to disclose AI-generated content</h3><p>Creators can label their videos while <a href="https://vimeo.com/upload" data-id="5-builder-79976fa3a047402aa270b1f007420c68">uploading them</a> (or do so later) from the <strong>Video settings</strong> page. Simply select a checkbox for <strong>AI-generated content</strong> with the option to select a checkbox for <strong>Audio</strong> or <strong>Visuals</strong>, or both. </p><h4>What doesn't require labeling</h4><p>Content that is clearly unrealistic, animated, includes obvious special effects, or uses AI for minor production assistance.</p></div></div><style data-id="builderio-block" nonce="">    </style><div builder-id="builder-2c702b45408d487baf15101ac5795d4a" class="builder-2c702b45408d487baf15101ac5795d4a builder-block"><figure><div class="asset-image-container relative undefined"><img src="https://f.vimeocdn.com/cms-images/2024/07/In-line-image-2.jpg?w=1024" alt="Vimeo's UI showing checkboxes to mark AI-generated content" title="Vimeo's UI showing checkboxes to mark AI-generated content" aria-hidden="false" loading="lazy" class="progressive-image block w-full max-w-full h-auto object-cover rounded-standard aspect-16/9 transform-gpu will-change-[object-position]"></div></figure></div><style data-id="builderio-block" nonce="">    </style><div builder-id="builder-4dfa5d9add544a47842be07f5b30b0ed" class="builder-4dfa5d9add544a47842be07f5b30b0ed builder-block"><div class="builder-text" style="outline: none;"><h3>A collective responsibility</h3><p>We’re excited to work with this community to shape the future of storytelling, as we have for the last two decades. We believe that a transparent platform is becoming an even more essential foundation for creators and viewers alike in this next generation of creativity. On behalf of everyone at Vimeo, thank you for taking this next step with us.</p></div></div></div></div><aside class="w-full p-8 md:w-[288px] md:p-0 relative"><div class="[&>.builder-blocks]:flex [&>.builder-blocks]:flex-col [&>.builder-blocks]:gap-8 md:sticky md:top-[110px] md:left-0 md:right-0"><style>.props-blocks-wrapper-8834791c {
